en: This is an old handwritten postcard with blue ink script in German. The left side of the first image includes an address (Absender/recipient fields) and a German postage stamp marked 'DILLINGEN (SAAR) 31.10.59'. The right side contains both an address and additional correspondence. The second image is the back, fully covered in neat handwritten German text, mentioning 'Josef Königsdorf 2.12.59'. There are no photographic illustrations or well-known landmarks pictured.
